Outcome: versioned workload/budget configuration, deterministic input identities, receipt schema and strict checks before timing/optimization.
Scope: docs/plans/PYMOVEMENTS_PERFORMANCE.md; tools/pymovements/{performance.json,performance.py,fixtures.py,test_performance.py,receipt.schema.json,performance-requirements.in,performance-requirements.txt,README.md}; docs inventory classification. No library algorithms, benchmark timing or performance win claims.
Invariants: every mandatory PM3 workload remains present, including currently missing QC/reading adapters; output semantics precede timing; scientific mismatches cannot enter speed aggregates; cold/warm/end-to-end/UI and RSS/heap/allocation remain distinct. Preserve source pins and name budgets before evidence.
Base: 827d01c30675ba7decf87d8cb13a940fdc4430de, stacked branch codex-pymovements-performance-protocol in /private/tmp/eyes4s-pm3-20260927/worktree. User authorized next slice while PM1.1 remains in review; do not misreport it landed.
Proposed change: frozen machine/runtime/dependency configuration; synthetic raw/annotated inputs at fixed scales plus existing public corpus and Studio fixture identities; numeric per-cell and aggregate gates; machine-readable receipt schema and validation of environment/input/output/instrument identities; tests with deliberately incomplete or incomparable receipts. Reuse PM3.2, existing ASC/Studio tooling, and create bounded adapter tickets only where no owner exists.
Acceptance: protocol/source and fixture checks, adversarial receipt tests, existing inventory regression, static docs and header/format/workflow/boundary checks on the exact tree. Report unrun full landing gates separately. No merge/push.
Next: finish dependency lock, fix workload semantics and budgets, then implement the checker and bounded ownership map.
